description:
List all clawops-managed stacks across all configured providers.

With fleet: true, also reads every stack's host over SSH and reports its host
agent: whether one is installed and running, which OpenClaw agent it serves, and,
on a fleet member (ADR 0015), its tag, its peers, its firewall table and its tailnet
state. Peers that cannot work are reported on the host that names them: a peer with
no host agent, one that does not serve peers, one that answers a tag this host does
not carry, or one reached by a name it does not have on the tailnet. Same reading as
`clawops fleet status`. Changes nothing.

On a host agent: this host and its fleet peers, and whether each peer answered.
With fleet: true it reads this host and asks each peer to report itself, then
checks them against each other the same way. A peer answers for itself only.

Use when: the user wants an overview of their deployments, asks "what
stacks do I have", or wants to compare stacks before an operation. With
fleet: true, when they ask which host agents are running, whether the fleet
is healthy, or why one host agent cannot reach another.

Do NOT use when: the user named a specific stack — use clawops_status
directly with that name. Do NOT pass fleet: true just to list stacks: it
connects to every host and takes up to 30 s for one that does not answer.

fleet.description: Also read each stack's host agent and fleet membership over SSH. Off by default: without it nothing leaves this machine

stackNames.description: With fleet: true, read only these stacks, comma-separated. Omitted = every stack in ~/.clawops/config.json

name: clawops_stacks_list
title: List Stacks
